role: The environment's arena: one reserved mapping made with the environment and carved into fixed-capacity slot pools (paths, livings with their parts, living-world list entries, item-world and falling/hanging entities, village doors, chunk bands), the pathfinder's arrays and the list slab (size-class blocks for the chunk tables and section lists); fixed_array for owner-made fixed arrays; the handles' stale checks.
gpu: the capacities are compile-time constants reserved as address space (committed as written); a GPU environment would size them by bytes per environment
live_arenas: a process-wide registry written when an environment is made or freed (the grave's scan reads it), never inside a tick
pool free chains are LIFO; ie_ent_release keeps the record (pool_give_keep) until the slot is taken again, because a stack_link may still read the count
notes: GPU audit item L3 (lane/gpuarena). Handles: lref (living.h), ieref (item_entity.h), fhref (fallhang.h) put the slot's 16-bit generation and the slot index under a 16-bit tag; the getters stop the program on a generation mismatch.
